items.title: How Much Track Is Left For MRVL Stock?
items.summary: A semiconductor star has posted a large run, but a pullback from its June peak forces every investor to ask if the high-octane growth is already baked into the price.

items.title: Is AMD Stock Priced Right Against Its Chip Peers?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock returned 291% over the past year, the best of five big chipmakers. It is also the priciest on earnings of the four with a comparable multiple, yet it keeps the lowest operating margin. Is AMD growing fast enough and getting more profitable fast enough to earn that price.

items.title: What Makes Credo Technology Stock A Buy Today?
items.summary: For Credo Technology (CRDO) investors, the worry is paying a high price for a stock that swings hard. The shares cost 67.7 times the past year's earnings, against 22.4 for the S&P 500. Past sell-offs have cut them by more than half. In its latest quarter, Credo's revenue more than doubled from a year earlier. So what does Credo have to keep delivering for that risk to pay off.

items.title: Marvell’s 203% YTD Surge Sets High Bar but We See More Runway Ahead
items.summary: After a 200-plus percent run this year, Marvell sits at a crossroads where one upcoming investor day could either justify its stretched valuation or expose a critical flaw at the heart of its AI growth story.
